description: Known answers for the canonical public identity of an mTLS public key (identity-registry section 5.2; lead decision, 2026-11-24): prefix followed by the 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits of the SHA-256 digest of the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo, which must be 1 to max_der_bytes bytes. A case's DER bytes are der.hex, then fill_count copies of the byte fill_byte when the case has them. expected is an identity, or the error class whose message both sides give. The operator does not check the DER structure; the service does and refuses what is not a strict DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo: a case with service_expected gives that service message instead of expected. Readers: operator/tests/operator.rs (public_identity_of_spki) and tests/harness/public_identity_fixture.rs (the service's canonical_public_identity). Sources of the keys: RFC 8032 section 7.1, test 1 (Ed25519) and RFC 6979 appendix A.2.5 (P-256); rsa_shape_4096_bytes is an rsaEncryption SubjectPublicKeyInfo of exactly max_der_bytes bytes whose key octets are filler, which the service does not decode.

messages.too_large: the public key is too large

service_expected.error: the public key encoding is truncated
the public key encoding has trailing bytes
the public key is not in DER encoding
the public key is not a SubjectPublicKeyInfo
